metadata.title: NPRA: Clinical Trials Safety Reporting (web page and FAQ)
metadata.edition: Web page with FAQ, updated 30 April 2025 (a page-update date, used as the effective date) · FAQ 6, 8, 11, 12, 13 and 17: SUSAR clocks, day zero and the local/foreign split
metadata.legal_basis: NPRA web guidance on clinical-trial safety reporting; the clinical-trial guidelines it refers to (not read) prevail.
metadata.applicability: Applicants, sponsors and market authorization holders reporting ICSRs (see the PV Info ICSR rulebook for scope).

metadata_verification: Source-register metadata; dates and legal status require human verification.
limitations: English rule-based extraction; no GPT or paid API.

candidates.anchor: FAQS on Safety Reporting in Clinical Trials (Updated 30 April 2025) / paragraph-9
candidates.statement: Local SUSAR (Malaysia trial sites): Individual SUSAR report in the format of CIOMS must be notified to NPRA.
candidates.context: It is an adverse reaction where the nature or severity of which is not consistent with the applicable product information (e.g. Investigator’s Brochure for an unapproved investigational product or package insert / summary of product characteristics for an approved product). SUSAR outside of Malaysia trial site: Only six-monthly SUSAR line listing report must be notified to NPRA. Individual SUSAR reports is not required.

candidates.anchor: FAQS on Safety Reporting in Clinical Trials (Updated 30 April 2025) / paragraph-10
candidates.statement: SUSAR outside of Malaysia trial site: Only six-monthly SUSAR line listing report must be notified to NPRA. Individual SUSAR reports is not required.
candidates.context: Local SUSAR (Malaysia trial sites): Individual SUSAR report in the format of CIOMS must be notified to NPRA. The report with an accompanying cover letter can be submitted via email to [official contact omitted; consult source].

candidates.anchor: FAQS on Safety Reporting in Clinical Trials (Updated 30 April 2025) / paragraph-13
candidates.statement: The reporting of local SUSAR commence on the date a notification of CTIL/CTX approval is received from NPRA. This activity must continue until the CTIL/CTX involved has expired or the End of Study Summary Reports have been submitted for all trial sites in Malaysia, whichever is later.
candidates.context: Acknowledgement of Receipt (AoR) will be generated for the reports submitted. It is acceptable to report six-monthly SUSAR Line Listing (SLL) according to global reporting timeline. However, SLL must be reported based on protocol specific in which Malaysia participates in. Individual SUSARs arising from trials which are not conducted in Malaysia is not required to report to NPRA.

candidates.anchor: FAQS on Safety Reporting in Clinical Trials (Updated 30 April 2025) / paragraph-14

However, SLL must be reported based on protocol specific in which Malaysia participates in. Individual SUSARs arising from trials which are not conducted in Malaysia is not required to report to NPRA.
candidates.context: The reporting of local SUSAR commence on the date a notification of CTIL/CTX approval is received from NPRA. This activity must continue until the CTIL/CTX involved has expired or the End of Study Summary Reports have been submitted for all trial sites in Malaysia, whichever is later. You can verify the receipt of SUSAR, SUSAR Line Listing and DSUR reports by sending the following details of your submission as a query to [official contact omitted; consult source]. Phone call follow-ups on this matter will generally not be entertained.

candidates.anchor: FAQS on Safety Reporting in Clinical Trials (Updated 30 April 2025) / paragraph-17
candidates.statement: The party responsible for safety reporting should be clearly stated in the Clinical Trial Agreement (CTA). In most of the cases, Company A is responsible for safety reporting for Trial A whereas Company B for Trial B. Thus, in the above scenario, only Company A should expedite the SUSAR report to NPRA.
candidates.context: (a) The subject of the email or SUSAR, SUSAR Line Listing and DSUR reports reference number (a) SUSAR Reports Line Listing(b) Development Safety Update Report (DSUR)(c) Annual Safety Report (ASR)
